description: Make a link to a MyGroceryPal page that prices a shopping list at every UK supermarket, with each store's total, links to buy at each store, and a button to save the list to a MyGroceryPal account. Needs no sign-in and stores nothing. Up to 40 lines; pin a productId on a line to keep the exact product the user chose. Give the user the url when they want to see the list, share it, or shop from it.

name.description: One shopping list line, e.g. 'semi-skimmed milk'

productId.description: Pin this exact product, a productId from search_grocery_prices or price_shopping_list. Leave out to let the page pick the best match.

quantity.description: How many to buy. Defaults to 1.

name: create_list_page
title: Create a shareable list page
